hints.title: Run Length Contribution
hints.text: A contiguous run of identical characters of length L produces L * (L + 1) // 2 valid single-character substrings.

hints.title: Contiguous Character Streaks
hints.text: Iterate through the string, maintaining the length of the current streak of identical characters.

hints.title: Accumulate Combinatorial Counts
hints.text: Whenever the current character matches the previous, increment the streak count and add it to total; otherwise reset streak count to 1 and add 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(N^2) substrings individually is unnecessarily quadratic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking the running streak length accumulates combinations in a single linear pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the arithmetic series sum formula L * (L + 1) // 2.
complexity.notes: Every streak increment immediately contributes its current length to the total.
